messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — our rollout containment drill highlighted a gap in feature-flag evaluation that prevented the auto-rollback from firing. Need explicit owners/timelines for remediation and a recurring drill cadence. cc @maria @sam

maria: Confirmed. error spike at ~03:14 during canary. Flag eval path missed new ENV var in the config loader, so rule never evaluated. Will file bug and add repro.

sam: I can take the bugfix for the flag evaluation code. ETA end of week (Fri).

licia: I’ll own test coverage — add a unit + integration test for flag evaluation and env-var permutations. Target: next Tue.

ops-bot: deploy log: canary deploy 2026-03-20T03:10 by @deploybot (sha: a1b2c3)

jason: Suggestion: add an auto-rollback policy that checks both error-rate and flag-eval failures. Prototype rule: if error_rate > 0.5% OR flag_eval_failures > 3 in 5m -> rollback. I can prototype the rule and a small lambda-based guard.

alex: That rule sounds good. We also need an ownership matrix doc and a small runbook snippet. I’ll draft the matrix, pinging owners for confirmation.

maria: Timeline: bug repro + bug report by EOD today, staging patch by Wed, prod patch + rollout guard by next Tue.

sam: Action items I’ll create GH issues: 1) fix flag eval bug (sam) 2) add auto-rollback rule (jason) 3) test harness for flag drift (licia) 4) dashboard alert and runbook link (devex-jay) 5) monthly tabletop drill + quarterly audit (ops).

devex-jay: I’ll add alert and a simple runbook. Alert query (promql): `sum(rate(application_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(application_requests[5m]))` > 0.005. Runbook will include quick rollback steps and who-to-ping.

product-lead-joe: Marking this as high priority for rollout safety. Happy to re-prioritize items in the roadmap to cover fixes.

alex: Please include a note in the postmortem that owners + timelines are: sam (fix) Fri, licia (tests) Tue, jason (rollback rule) Mon, devex-jay (alerts) Thu, ops (drill schedule) Apr 05. I’ll update the postmortem doc after we confirm GH issue numbers.

sam: Linking PR when ready — will reference this thread.

maria: I’ll add the repro logs and a short sequence diagram to the postmortem so the eval path is clear.

alex: Thanks everyone. Plan: owners create GH issues today, we verify staging patch Wed, add rollback rule + automated gating next week. Monthly drills starting Apr 05. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: tabletop-drill Apr 05 09:00 — channel #eng-platform

alex: Closing loop — will post updated postmortem with owner matrix and timelines once GH issues exist.
